template.title: Turkish Commercial / State Bank Sustainable & Green Transformation Loan Application
template.governing_standard: BRSA (BDDK) Sustainable Banking Guidelines, Turkish Green Taxonomy & EU CBAM Readiness
template.typical_review_timeline: 1–4 weeks (Branch/Corporate RM Intake -> Green Eligibility Check -> Credit Approval)

fields.label: Company Legal Name & Masked Tax ID (VKN)
fields.description: Legal company name with PII-safe masked tax ID (full VKN injected only at final bank portal export).

fields.label: Enterprise Segment (SME / Mid-Cap / Corporate / Exporter)
fields.description: Determines credit desk routing (KOBİ / Ticari / Kurumsal).

fields.label: Selected COP31 Green Financing Package / Credit Line
fields.description: Matches applicant to the bank's exact COP31 product (e.g., GEFF Türkiye, Halkbank 100B Package, Ziraat CBAM / Green Export Loan, Yapı Kredi Dönüşüme Tam Destek, Garanti BBVA Sustainable Loan, Akbank 2.5T Program, VakıfBank ADB SME Line, QNB Proparco Green Leasing).

fields.label: Requested Financing Amount (USD eq.) & Tenor
fields.description: Requested loan/leasing ticket checked against the bank's green program limits.

fields.label: Eligible Green Use of Proceeds & Technology Description
fields.description: Details renewable energy (GES/RES), energy efficiency, circular economy, EV/e-mobility, or water-saving investment scope.

fields.label: Carbon Footprint Reduction (tCO2e/yr) & EU CBAM Export Impact
fields.description: Quantifies annual emissions reduction and EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) compliance benefits.

fields.label: Collateral / Kredi Garanti Fonu (KGF) Guarantee Eligibility
fields.description: Checks collateral backing or KGF treasury-backed guarantee readiness.

fields.label: Inclusive Finance Eligibility (Women/Youth Entrepreneur / Regional Priority)
fields.description: Flags preferential terms available for women-led SMEs, young entrepreneurs, or earthquake-affected/priority provinces.

fields.label: Financial Performance Snapshot (Annual Revenue, EBITDA, Project Capex)
Environmental Permits (ÇED / EIA) & Vendor Green Certification
fields.description: Confirms Turkish environmental permit status and green equipment verification.

fields.label: Relationship Manager Executive Credit & Sustainability Note
fields.description: Ready-to-submit green credit narrative tailored to this Turkish bank's COP31 mandate.
